options.label: Fast travel hotkey
options.description:
Opens fast travel from anywhere while you play, the same as Fast Travel on the map. Press it again to close the fast travel menu. Unbound turns the hotkey off.

In a mission, the first press asks. Then hold it for 5 seconds to abandon the mission and fast travel.

The default is the key left of 1 (` and ~ on US keyboards). For a controller, see FastTravelPlus: Controller.
